metadata.title: The 288 four-axis forms of three-colour 12×12 tilings — La Livrée d'Hermès (data, images and scripts)
metadata.description:
The family of 288 three-colour 12 × 12 tilings with four mirror axes (vertical, horizontal and the two diagonals), a single motif in the tiling (the half-period shift, six cells in each direction, exchanges two tints), 48 / 48 / 48 cells per tint, and readable by the binary reading of the corpus (72 dark / 72 light cells, the reading being inverted by the shift). Each form is given by one representative grid (a form is a class modulo torus translation).

  • 32 forms are those of the already deposited corpus that have four axes;
  • 256 forms are new: they are built from new layers, symmetric about the centre of the cell, which are not among the 360 plates of the complete set.

Only five fixed-tint bases (socles) pass the binary reading: the corpus type (8 fixed cells at each of the six levels, 32 forms) and four types A to D (64 forms each) with unequal weights, in which one level changes nothing for types B, C and D.

Contents. data/: the 288 forms (JSON and CSV) and the 3,552 four-axis layer couples among which these 288 are the ones perfect for the binary reading; svg/: one SVG per form; planches/: three PNG sheets; repro/: the scripts that recompute everything (to be run from a copy of the repository, with the same relative paths); SHA256SUMS.txt; LISEZMOI.md (in French).

Limits. The 256 new forms do not close the cube (they fall outside the classification of the companion note on the half-shift criterion); the plates of their layers have not been studied. Only the forms whose axes pass between cells are reached with the six-level map of the system; 3,200 further perfect four-axis forms (axes through cell centres) exist and need another map. No meaning is attributed to the patterns.

Licence. Data and images: CC BY-NC 4.0. Scripts: AGPL v3 (commercial licence on request).

Français. Les 288 formes de pavages 12 × 12 à trois teintes qui ont quatre axes de miroir, un seul motif au pavage, 48 / 48 / 48 cases par teinte, lisibles par la lecture binaire du corpus : 32 formes du corpus et 256 formes nouvelles. Voir LISEZMOI.md dans l’archive.

Author. Anibal Edelberto Amiot — ORCID 0009-0002-6414-9448 — Wikidata Q141191562 — anibal-amiot.com.

Page on the author's site: https://anibal-amiot.com/travaux/four-axis-forms-288/.
